Music Box II and Corral Radio both show the vanilla Music Box icon (no drawn "II" badge).

Open world: tracker under the minimap
Turn on the gordo, plort door, research drone, ghostly drone and map node rows.
Go to a zone that has them.
Gordos: the small Slimepedia gordo face (iconGordoPedia_small).
Ghostly drones: the blue explorer drone (iconExplorerDronePedia).
Plort doors: their map marker sprites.
Map nodes: the pediaHomeWorld tile (or the old drawn map if that sprite isn't loaded).
The Mods tab still shows your drawing.
Restart the game and touch nothing.
The last save loads by itself; no FAILED / faulted notice.
Click Continue yourself as soon as the menu shows.
The save loads once: no fault, no second load.
Restart and hold Shift until the main menu is up.
You stay in the main menu; "Staying in the main menu" shows briefly.
Set Auto-continue delay to 5 s and restart.
While it counts down, open Load Game.
Nothing loads while the submenu is open.
Go back to the main menu: it continues after the delay.
Gadget menu refreshes after a craft
Open the gadget-mode menu on a category (e.g. Decor).
Open the mod menu > Sandbox > Fabricator and craft 5 of a decoration in that category.
The new count / item shows without switching tabs or reopening.
With the gadget menu closed, craft a gadget in Sandbox.
Close the mod menu and open the gadget menu.
The gadget shows with its new count.
Sandbox > Vacpack: right-click a slot that holds an item.
Buttons read "Fill" and "Empty", no amount in brackets.
Hover Fill: the tooltip shows count / max.
Chicken program with a full Ash Trough
Station with 2 programs: Plorts -> Refinery, and Meats / Outside Plots -> Incinerator.
Fill the incinerator's Ash Trough completely, with chickens running outside the plots.
Let the plort program finish: within ~10 s the drone switches to the chicken program and rests (no room to burn).
Empty the Ash Trough: within ~40 s the drone starts collecting chickens and burns them.
Key glyphs like the silo receipt
Open a drone station menu: the [P] Programs pill's key glyph looks like the silo Sell-All receipt's.
Select Plort Market: the [C] Limit pill has the same look.
Press P: the dialog's Close shows P with the same look; Edit / Remove / Add program / mode buttons have no glyph.
Click the pills and Close with the mouse: they still open and close.
Open the overlay (F8) and press Tab repeatedly.
Focus goes through sidebar entries, Dark/Light, build stamp, top-bar tabs, reset, switch, (?) and close, then every row control on the page; each gets a blue rounded ring.
Press Shift+Tab repeatedly: same stops in reverse, never stuck between the search box and a grid.
On a page with switches (e.g. Movement), Tab to a switch and press Space: it toggles and its tooltip shows.
Tab to a sidebar entry or top-bar tab and press Enter: that page opens.
Sandbox > Upgrades: Tab into the entries: one stop, first entry ringed.
Arrow keys move entry by entry across both columns.
Blueprint sub-tab: Tab past the search box into the grid: one stop.
Arrows move tile by tile and scroll the grid.
Space on a tile unlocks / locks it.
Tab, then Shift+Tab: focus leaves the grid each way.
Vacpack slots and picker by keyboard
Sandbox > Vacpack: Tab to the slot row, Left/Right moves slot by slot, Space selects.
On a slot with an item press the Menu key (or Shift+F10): the give menu opens.
Tab into the picker grid, use arrows: the focused tile shows its tooltip; Enter puts the item in the slot.
Hover an empty slot and a locked slot: tooltips as wide as a slime with favourites.
Slime DJ: Tab into the song list: one stop.
Right focuses that song's +; Enter queues it.
Tab leaves the list for the Now playing buttons.
Sandbox icon: same size as the others, round tips, no sharp spikes.
Profiles icon: three lines with round ends.
Open Ranch > General: Custom Upgrades full width on top, Plot Upgrades and Sell Upgrades side by side under it.
Toggle each card's switch: each works.
Turn Custom Upgrades off: its card greys out.
Ranch: corral with a Music Box
Overlay Slime DJ: turn on "Walls dance to the music".
Play a song with a quiet intro or breakdown (e.g. AVE MARIA (HARDSTYLE), ANOTHER LOVE HARDSTYLE) next to the corral.
Quiet intro: walls glow faintly, no ripples, slow colour changes.
Drop: ripples and strong colour changes on every kick, as snappy as before.
Breakdown: walls calm down again within ~1 s.
Ranch: 2+ corrals with Music Boxes close together
Slime DJ volume 100 % and game music volume 100 %.
Amplify off: play a song between the corrals, note the loudness.
Amplify on: a bit louder (~+4 dB with 4+ speakers), no crackle or jumps every half second.
Walk from one music box to the other: the sound clearly comes from the box you're next to.
Buy the Music Box and the Corral Radio for a corral.
Within ~1 s a blue button appears outside the free corner post (the auto-feeder corner).
Press E: press animation and click, the "Corral Radio" menu opens, game paused, cursor free.
Sell the Corral Radio from the plot menu: the button disappears at once.
Open the menu from the blue button.
Click a song on the left: it's added at the end of the playlist, "Added …" shows.
Press Radio: "Radio: on", status "Now playing: …"; Shuffle toggles the same way.
Select an entry: Up, Down, Remove and Play move it, remove it, or make it the pink playing entry.
Clear once: orange "Press Clear again…"; again: playlist empty, radio off.
Add songs, radio on, Done: menu closes, game unpauses, the corral plays the playlist; the overlay's Corral radios card shows the same list.
Build a playlist with the blue button's menu.
Save, quit to the menu and reload.
Press the button: the playlist is kept.
Up/Down (W/S), Left/Right, Tab, Page Up/Down: a teal cursor moves through songs, playlist and buttons; holding Down scrolls.
Enter on a song adds it.
On a playlist entry: Shift+Down moves it down, Delete removes it.
R toggles the radio, F toggles shuffle.
Mouse wheel scrolls the list under it.
Esc closes; clicking the dark area outside the panel closes too.
Turn the Slime DJ module off in the overlay.
Press the blue button: orange "Slime DJ is off (overlay: Ranch > Slime DJ)" above it, no menu.
Turn Slime DJ on, press again: the menu opens.
DJ Booth, DJ Speaker Stack and Slime Radio cards: pink desk, orange boombox, cyan boombox icons, on the tile and the details picture.
Open the Fabricator > Upgrades and select Shadow Catcher.
The details picture is the shadow slime, not the vac tank art.
Hold a Scientist Desk with a DJ Booth kit, press Variant until it shows DJ Booth, place it: the dressed booth appears at once, no vanilla desk first.
The middle boombox stands upright facing forward, like the corner ones.
Hold a Boombox with a speaker kit, toggle to DJ Speaker Stack, place it: the stack appears at once.
Aim at a placed plain Boombox (kit left) and press Variant: it turns into a stack immediately.
Spawn or fabricate a Slime Radio and switch on a Slime DJ song.
Walk into it and let slimes play with it: it moves a little and stops, no long sliding.
Vac it and hold it at the nozzle 5+ s: it stays visible and keeps playing.
Shoot it out / let go: it lands upright and keeps playing.
Options > Misc > Debug Tools: switch on "Show entity hitboxes".
Close the menu, look at slimes, toys and gadgets: green wireframes on solid colliders, blue boxes on mesh colliders.
Switch on "Include trigger zones": yellow trigger volumes appear too.
Look at a Slime Radio: the box matches the little speaker stack (note any mismatch).
Hitbox range 4 m: only nearby colliders drawn.
Look at a placed link for 20 s.
A smaller glow that never disappears; only an occasional brief jitter.
Press E on the link: the drone station menu opens on the Quantum Cloud tab with cloud amounts, no programming tab.
Esc closes it; controls work normally.
Open a real drone station: it still has the programming tab and works as before.
Open a drone station > Programming > Source.
The Quantum Storage Link icon is not wider than the other source icons.
